aptly_url.description: URL to Aptly API endpoint (e.g., http://localhost:8080)

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for Aptly API requests; increase for large publishes

default_architectures.description: List of architectures to publish by default

publish_contents.description: Whether to generate and publish the Contents file (slower)

default_components.description: Default components (e.g., ['main', 'contrib']) to use for publish/promote actions

only_latest.description: Publish only the latest version of each package

default_source.description: Default source publish pattern (e.g., 'jessie(/?.*)/nightly') for promote

default_target.description: Default target publish format (e.g., 'jessie{0}/testing') for promote

show_diff.description: Show differences between snapshots before promotion

hard_cleanup.description: Hard-delete unused packages and snapshots during cleanup
